title: A Salt for the Hollow
author: Paloma Ravensworth
blurb: Sebastian Winterbourne, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
